name: HooverMsg
meaning: Messages handled by Hoover_HandleMessage 0x4cb550 (plus ids it sends)

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach, place, snap, anim 0 - state unchanged

name: MSG_HOOVER_CHARGED
meaning: from the master Battery at 5 batteries: battery = sender, charged = 1, arm if in hand

name: MSG_HOOVER_GHOST_CAUGHT
meaning: from the Ghost when its sucked anim ends (0x44ca32): unfreeze the Wolf, Wolf msg 0x4E arg 0, battery 0x4404 arg 0
